newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle at standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle at standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry.

There were 20,700 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 10,800 head of formulated cattle and 100 head previously contracted to be shipped this week and 1,500 head or 41 loads of CME cattle delivered to area packing plants.
Confirmed - None Week Ago - 32,100 Year Ago - 2,300
Wk to date - 20,700 Week Ago - 51,300 Year Ago - 15,800
